day_shape: CENTCOM says US Navy and Air Force jets struck 10 Iranian military targets near the Strait of Hormuz over the drone attack on M/T Kiku; IRGC claims a 2-3am missile-and-drone response, while Netanyahu unveils withdrawal lines under the new US-Israel-Lebanon trilateral deal and IDF reports multiple Hamas commanders killed in Gaza.

threads.label: US strikes on Iranian targets near Hormuz
threads.summary: CENTCOM said US Navy and Air Force fighters struck 10 Iranian military targets in and near the Strait of Hormuz in response to Iran's drone attack on the tanker M/T Kiku. Iran's foreign ministry condemned the strikes as a violation, and IRGC channels claimed a joint missile-and-drone retaliation between 2 and 3am on 7 Tir.

threads.label: Israel-Lebanon trilateral deal rollout
threads.summary: Netanyahu held a press conference detailing IDF withdrawal locations under the newly signed US-Israel-Lebanon agreement, while Defence Minister Katz called it historic and said the IDF would retain a security zone including the Beaufort Castle ridge. Netanyahu also announced an intention to form a "broad national government" alongside the announcement.

threads.label: IDF strikes in south Lebanon and Syria
threads.summary: The IDF said its air force killed several Hezbollah operatives armed with RPGs in the Nabatieh area and destroyed a launch platform, while Brigade 210 forces eliminated armed individuals in the southern Syria security zone. IRIB reported an Israeli strike on Deir Seryan a day after the ceasefire signing.

threads.label: Gaza: IDF kills named Hamas commanders
threads.summary: The IDF announced the killing of Hamas naval police commander Mansour Sami Mahmoud Shahtout and two other commanders in central Gaza, Khan Yunis tunnel unit head Kamal Najjar, and Nukhba commanders Abd al-Rahman Ziyada and Walid Haniyeh (nephew of Ismail Haniyeh). All were named as participants in or planners of attacks linked to October 7.

threads.label: Araghchi visit to Baghdad
threads.summary: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi travelled to Baghdad for talks with Iraqi counterpart Fouad Hussein, per IRIB and Jerusalem Post citing Mehr News. Defa Press said Araghchi also visited the site near Baghdad airport where Qassem Soleimani and Abu Mahdi al-Muhandis were killed.

threads.label: Hormuz sovereignty messaging and Gulf reaction
threads.summary: Parliament national security commission head Azizi told Defa Press that Iran's sovereignty over the Strait of Hormuz was steadfast and that foreign vessels must use only IRGC-designated routes. Bahrain condemned what it called continued Iranian attacks and called on the UN to hold Tehran accountable, while Jerusalem Post reported a dispute over Hormuz "services" and "costs" wording between the US, Iran and Oman.

threads.label: Regime resistance and army-readiness messaging
threads.summary: Defa Press ran a sequence of interviews with army spokesman Amir Akraminia claiming the 40-day "Ramadan war" had consolidated the resistance front and that advanced equipment was being added to the army. Judiciary head Ejehi was quoted attacking US human rights claims, and Commander Hasanzadeh announced funeral arrangements for the "martyred leader" on 14-15 Tir.

events.title: A top commander in Hamas's naval police, along with two other operatives in the terror group, were killed in an Israeli strike in the central Gaza Strip over the weekend, the IDF announces. The IDF says the naval police "operates under Hamas's military wing and advances and directs terror attacks against IDF troops and the State of Israel." The strike on Friday targeted Mansour Sami Mahmoud Shahtout, the commander of Hamas's naval police in the Central Camps, according to the military. Two other commanders in the naval police who were with Shahtout in the targeted vehicle were killed in the strike, the military says. The IDF says Shahtout recently worked to advance attacks on Israeli troops.

events.title: The IDF says it struck and killed several Hezbollah operatives who were armed with RPGs and operating close to troops in south Lebanon yesterday. After the operatives were identified, the Israeli Air Force carried out strikes on the operatives and the structure they were in in the Nabatieh area, "to remove the threat to the forces," the military says. In a separate incident, troops of the Multi-Domain Unit struck and destroyed a Hezbollah rocket launcher that the military says "posed a threat to forces."
events.summary:

In a separate incident, troops of the Multi-Domain Unit struck and destroyed a Hezbollah rocket launcher that the military says "posed a threat to forces."

Ayouz unit forces of Brigade 36 spotted yesterday a number of Hezbollah terrorists armed with RPG grenades in the Nabatieh area, near the security zone where IDF forces operate in south Lebanon. Upon spotting them, the air force attacked and eliminated them and destroyed the building they were operating from in order to remove the threat to our forces. In another strike in the area, forces destroyed a launch platform belonging to the terrorist Hezbollah which posed a threat to our forces.
